subheading: CLINICAL FEATURES OF WAX IN THE EAR
subheading_corrected: CLINICAL FEATURES OF WAX IN THE EAR
text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF WAX IN THE EAR
- Sensation of blockage and some degree of deafness are the most common
complaints
- Sometimes, pain and irritation
- Ear discharge in some cases
- Quantity seen varies
- May be soft or hard
- May be impacted in the deep meatus
